lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters are arranged in loose vertical columns. A central group of four spots forms a distinct trapezoidal arrangement posterior to the gill slits, with a fifth spot positioned ventrally to form a pentagonal cluster.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive caustic light patterns caused by surface water refraction are overlaid across the entire visible dermal surface, appearing as a high-contrast net-like structure.
